reply:
I'm down 2 points at the start, so mutual cooperation every round would leave me losing 24-26. Defecting guarantees I win unless Palmer defects *all* 8 rounds (8-10). Any single Palmer cooperation while I defect flips the lead. Cooperating, meanwhile, guarantees a loss regardless of Palmer's play. Defect is the only path to victory.
